prompt: Close-up of a whole, uncut chilled four-serving layered apple dessert in its small 15 x 20 cm clear glass baking dish. A thin base of rectangular spice biscuits is darkened and softened by espresso, topped with a generous layer of fully cooled apple compote: peeled, irregularly diced apples simmered until tender but still recognisable, pale honey-gold with lightly syrupy juices and fine cinnamon specks. Above this sits a thick, smooth pale-ivory mascarpone and whipped-cream layer flecked with tiny vanilla seeds. The level top has a light dusting of cocoa and four dry, crisp, embossed brown biscuits resting flat on it. Through the near glass side, the moist biscuit base, fruit layer and cream remain distinct in their original order. The dessert fills most of the square frame, with the dish edges partly cropped. A 65-degree camera angle shows both the cocoa-dusted surface and the side layers. Bright soft natural daylight gives crisp detail and true-to-life colours, against a calm pale warm-wood surface with clean, unmarked surroundings.

The lemon juice and sugar are dissolved into the compote; cinnamon appears as fine brown specks. There is no roasted or caramelised browning.

visible_ingredients.recipe_quantity_and_visual_proportion: 100 ml total (25 ml per serving), distributed over the biscuit base and absorbed into it rather than forming a separate sauce.
visible_ingredients.real_life_appearance: Visible only through uneven deeper coffee-brown moistening of the base biscuits, which look saturated and tender without surrounding liquid.

visible_ingredients.recipe_quantity_and_visual_proportion: Quantity not specified; the recipe calls for only a little cocoa immediately before serving, so it is a light surface dusting rather than a thick coating.
visible_ingredients.real_life_appearance: A fine, slightly uneven matte brown veil over the smoothed cream, leaving some pale ivory visible; applied before the four reserved biscuits are placed on top.

recipe_result: A whole, uncut chilled family-style dessert for four in a 15 x 20 cm baking dish, layered with espresso-softened spiced biscuits, fully cooked and cooled cinnamon-apple compote and smooth vanilla mascarpone cream, then lightly dusted with cocoa and topped with four whole spiced biscuits.

final_plating_from_recipe: Following step 3, the biscuits except for the four reserved pieces cover the bottom of a 15 x 20 cm baking dish and are sprinkled with espresso; the fully cooled apple compote is spread over them, followed by the mascarpone cream, which is smoothed flat. Following step 4, the assembled dessert is chilled for at least two hours, lightly dusted with cocoa before serving and finished with the four reserved biscuits on top. It is shown whole and uncut in its baking dish, with no separately served accompaniment.

recipe_instructions.instruction:
Für das Kompott die Äpfel abbrausen, trocken reiben, schälen, vierteln und entkernen. Das Fruchtfleisch würfeln und mit Zitronensaft, Zucker sowie Zimt in einen Topf 
geben. Alles bei mittlerer Hitze unter Rühren 10 Minuten köcheln, dann vollständig auskühlen lassen.
Für die Creme Mascarpone mit Zucker und Vanillemark glatt rühren. Die Sahne steif schlagen und unterziehen. Anschließend die Masse kühlen.

Die Spekulatius (bis auf 4 Stück zum Garnieren) auf den Boden einer Auflaufform (ca. 15 x 20 cm) legen und mit dem Espresso beträufeln. Das Kompott darauf verteilen, 
dann die Creme daraufgeben und glatt streichen.
Das Tiramisu mind. 2 Stunden (oder über Nacht) kalt stellen. Vor dem Servieren das Tiramisu mit etwas Kakao bestäuben und mit den übrigen Keksen belegen.

final_plating_instruction: Das Tiramisu mind. 2 Stunden (oder über Nacht) kalt stellen. Vor dem Servieren das Tiramisu mit etwas Kakao bestäuben und mit den übrigen Keksen belegen.
